summary.name: Recordly
summary.one_liner: Recordly is a free, open-source screen recorder and timeline editor for making polished demos, walkthroughs, and product videos with auto-zoom and animated cursors.
use_cases: Making tutorial videos with zoom effects
Producing looping GIFs for social posts
Recording narrated screen demos with mic and system audio
summary.what_it_does: Recordly records screens and adds automatic zoom effects, smooth animated cursor styling, and background framing to recordings. A drag-and-drop timeline lets users adjust speed, zooms, annotations, audio tracks, and length. It captures microphone and system audio as two sources and can import external audio files and webcam video. Projects save as .recordly files so they can be reopened and edited later. Output can be exported as MP4 or a looping GIF.
notable: Built-in auto-zoom and animated cursor styling
Save and reopen projects as .recordly files
Looping cursor path for seamless GIFs
Positioned as a free alternative to Screen Studio
caveats: Commercial-use and platform-support answers are in the FAQ but their text was not included on the page, so details are unverified
